entries.title: Listening Challenge: Catch the Final Step
entries.hook: The message gives three steps. Which one is the final action?

turns.speaker: message
turns.text: The parcel leaves our warehouse today. You will receive the tracking number tonight, and the courier will call before delivery.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Three steps: warehouse, tracking, courier call.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: The final action is the courier call. The last step is the one you act on.

entries.visualBrief: Bright modern delivery desk scene with an adult traveller checking a phone beside parcel shelves, chest-up framing, hands below frame, teal and warm orange palette, no readable text.

entries.title: End a Conversation: The Summary Line
entries.hook: The summary line is the friendliest exit in English.

turns.speaker: friend_a
turns.text: Right, I will let you get on. We solved the venue question, and I will send the price tonight.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: The summary names what is settled and what happens next. Then the exit needs nothing more.

entries.prompt: What does the summary line contain?
entries.answer: What is settled and the next step.
entries.visualBrief: Bright anime library corner with two adult friends ending a warm conversation near a staircase, relaxed daylight, chest-up framing, hands below frame, soft green and amber palette, no readable text.

entries.title: Listening Challenge: Repair the Mistake
entries.hook: Every section ends with an answer and a repair. That is the method.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: You answer section one: Tuesday, gate twenty-four, one bag.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: The repair explains the trap: gate twenty was the first announcement, not the final one.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Answers with repairs build the habit. That is why the marathon works.

entries.answer: The trap that caused the wrong first answer.
entries.visualBrief: Calm bright study nook with headphones resting beside a notebook and a cup on a wooden desk, morning light, no people, hands out of frame, warm cream and slate palette, no readable text.

entries.title: Conversation Exits: The Forward Promise
entries.hook: Which line opens a door instead of closing one?

turns.speaker: friend_a
turns.text: I have to run, but tell me how the interview goes on Thursday.

turns.speaker: friend_b
turns.text: Thursday, not yet. Which exit leaves the door open?

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: The forward promise names a next meeting. That is the exit that keeps the friendship warm.

entries.prompt: Which exit keeps the door open?
entries.answer: The forward promise of a next meeting.
entries.visualBrief: Bright anime evening street with two adult friends parting with a friendly wave under warm street lamps, chest-up framing, hands mostly below frame, navy amber and coral palette, no readable text.
